findings.evidence: grep/nl: `ComplexLine.lean:87:lemma stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm (z w : ℂ) :` with no preceding `@[simp]`; the base coordinate evaluator at lines 79-81 is tagged `[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to this lemma so goals involving the associated bilinear form normalize to the real dot product.
findings.issue: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm` is the coordinate normal form for the compatible metric but is not tagged `[simp]`.

findings.evidence: grep/nl: `ComplexLine.lean:93:lemma stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self (z : ℂ) :` gives the squared-coordinate formula with no preceding `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to this lemma so standard-line positivity and energy goals reduce to `z.re * z.re + z.im * z.im` without naming it manually.
findings.issue: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self` is the normal form for `ω(z, J z)` but is not tagged `[simp]`.

summary: The exposed complex-line API has the coordinate formulas, but two characteristic normal forms are public without the automation annotations expected for downstream metric and energy computations.
